account-locked: Konti yugariwe akanya kubera kugerageza kwinjira incuro nyinshi bikanka. Turagusavye wongere ugerageze hanyuma.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel ni iya SuperAdmin gusa, kuri domene ya Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Na WeKan muri Weddy, Cloud Panel ikorera amadomene menshi ya WeKan ivuye kuri seriveri imwe, imwe imwe ifise amakuru yayo. Kuri domene ya Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin aracunga amadomene na CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ufise urufunguzo rwa CloudFlare API, domene ifise akarere kayo muri konti yawe ya CloudFlare iraronka icandikwa ca DNS gicishwa muri proxy n'icemezo ca CloudFlare Origin. Ayandi madomene araronka icemezo ca Let's Encrypt. Urufunguzo rubikwa kuri seriveri kandi ntiruzokwerekanwa ukundi.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Nta rufunguzo rwa CloudFlare API rwabitswe: domene yose iraronka icemezo ca Let's Encrypt.
error-notAuthorized: Nta burenganzira ufise bwo kubona uru rupapuro.
